status_definitions.measurement_observation: the source measures hand/finger and ball in the same throw; does not require bone centers
status_definitions.public_original: downloaded usable original research data files; excludes paper graphs; C3D can be processed/gap-filled
status_definitions.synchronization: hand and ball share a stated capture clock; not a bound on absolute physical timing error
status_definitions.calibration: independently checked camera scale/geometry adequate for ball-center mechanics
status_definitions.radar_linkage: same-trial speedgun record with verified units and definition
status_definitions.release_validation: physical contact-ending event independently validated beyond a distance/kinematic proxy
